title: AUREN Global Investor, Venture Capital and Investment Promotion Sources — Batch 36 (50 Countries)
scope: 50 candidate investor-network, venture-capital, private-equity and investment-promotion sources across 50 countries.
source_policy: Catalog candidates only; not verified live integrations and not a guarantee that a public investor directory exists.
Manually validate current URL, organization status, investor/member directory availability, investment stage, sector coverage, geographic scope and contact/application requirements.
Investment promotion agencies are not necessarily investors and may provide facilitation rather than direct capital.
Do not imply any investor is accepting applications or that any investment is guaranteed.
API availability, licensing, data freshness and terms are not assessed.
HTTP 403, anti-bot responses and timeouts are not by themselves evidence that a URL is broken.
